subject: Air freight quote request: STR to MEL
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Could you please provide an all-in air freight quote in EUR from STR to MEL (Melbourne, AU)? The shipment will be ready on 2026-11-26, and we will deliver it to STR ourselves.

The shipment consists of 6 pieces of printed marketing material, with a gross weight of 1841 kg and a total volume of 4.63 cbm.

The goods must arrive at MEL no later than 2026-12-02. Among the options that meet this deadline, price will determine our choice.

Thank you in advance for your quotation.

Kind regards
Anna Sonnberg
Head of Purchasing and Logistics
Sonnberg Kaffeeroesterei GmbH
